The son of [[Chris (DS)|Chris]] and [[Wally (DS)|Wally]], Hugh aspires to be like his father. He is quite the athlete, and exercises with his father regularly. He looks up to his father and hopes to win a gold medal one day. He is full of energy and has a big imagination. Hugh likes to spend time outside, and can be found at the Goddess Pond and Turtle Pond. He will also occasionally visit the Inner Inn.  When your child is born, Hugh will grow into a teenager. His appearance changes as well as his likes and dislikes. He becomes more rebellious, and focuses even more on fitness than he did as a child.
